help_text:
🛍️ Help Center

📦 Browse products, add them to your cart, and confirm your order at checkout.
💳 Payments: Choose Telebirr, CBE, or Chapa from the available checkout options.
🚚 Enter your delivery address at checkout and follow your order from My Orders.
🕒 Support hours: Our team replies during regular business hours. You can submit a ticket any time.
{support_contacts}
